Thinking, thinking of, having an idea of; मनसा$निष्टचिन्तनम्
Sad or sorrowful thought, care, anxiety; चिन्ताजडं दर्शनम् Ś.4.5; so वीतचिन्तः 12.

.-Comp. -आकुल a. full of care, disturbed in mind, anxious. -कर्मन् n. anxiety. -पर a. thoughtful, anxious.

चिन्तितिः [cintitiḥ], f. चिन्तिया Consideration, reflection, thought.

To be considered or thought over.
To be discovered, to be devised or found out.
